info.name: Get specifications by product including not offered anymore

params.name: product
params.description:
Get specifications by product. Possible values
  • "IBN" for Cloud Number
  • "ITFS" for International Freephone Number
  • "GMN" for Global Mobile Number

params.name: country
params.description: Get specifications by country in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format.

params.name: profile
params.description: Tariff differentiation within a country. It intervenes in the billing. Only valid in combination with country.

params.name: includeNotOfferedAnymore
params.description: Show specifications for active numbers for products and countries that are not offered anymore.

items.docs: This method allows you to get specifications/restrictions for products offered within your pricelist and/or inventory.
